summary: A task inside a Delivery now binds only the switch values that Delivery pinned. `task_inputs.py` accepts `--delivery DLV-###` and also treats a task whose inputs lie in a Delivery package as inside that Delivery. While the pin is enforced, before the Delivery Review, an approved policy that changed the value, with its parameters, of a switch the task's flows own refuses the derivation with the same finding `process_policy.py value --delivery` reports, instead of binding the new policy's switch references; a policy that changes none of them, one with every switch at its default included, agrees with a Delivery that pinned none. A new execution approval, which re-pins the Delivery, or a later revision that sets the values back clears the refusal. A `/delivery-plan`, `/execution-plan` or `/configure` task binds the approved policy instead before the Delivery's first execution approval and while its plan-revision barrier is held on the remote Fence, so a running Delivery can move to a changed value through a plan revision; `--remote` names the remote whose Fence is read. From the Delivery Review on, and for an Item reopened after it, the task binds the values of the revision the Delivery pinned, read from Git history by the pinned source hash when the policy moved on, and a pin that cannot be read back refuses the derivation. Tasks outside a Delivery follow the current policy.
